name: Kometa
description: Kometa is a powerful tool designed to give you complete control over your media libraries. With Kometa, you can take your customization to the next level, with granular control over metadata, collections, overlays, and much more.
short_desc: Kometa is a powerful tool designed to give you complete control over your media libraries
author: linuxserver.io

form_fields.label: KOMETA_CONFIG
form_fields.hint: Specify a custom config file to use.

form_fields.label: KOMETA_TIMES
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated list of times to update each day. Format: HH:MM.

form_fields.label: KOMETA_RUN
form_fields.hint: Set to True to run without the scheduler.

form_fields.label: KOMETA_TESTS
form_fields.hint: Set to True to run in debug mode with only collections that have test: true.

form_fields.label: KOMETA_NO_MISSING
form_fields.hint: Set to True to run without any of the missing movie/show functions.
